Alternative labels: 

## Definition and typical features 
These studies develop guidance to help health researchers or other interest holders report methods, typically providing a checklist with explanation. The development process may combine multiple methods research approaches.

## Boundaries to related purposes

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples 
[Consensus study among researchers or other interest-holders in health research](../approaches/8consensus.qmd): Delphi study to develop CONSORT reporting guideline.[@Hopewell2025consort]

[Review of applied methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): review of observational studies emulating a target trial to inform the TARGET reporting guideline.[@Cashin2025transparent]

[Scoping review of methods research](../approaches/11scoping-review-mr.qmd): A scoping review informed the development of a new reporting guideline for factorial trials.[@Kahan2023reporting]
